library(readxl)

```{r print_inhosp, eval = TRUE}
display.cols <- c('COLUMN', 'LABEL', 'DISPLAY_NAME', 'DESCRIPTION', 'CALCULATIONS')

kable(
  rbind(display.cols, cb_geos[display.cols]),
  format = "html",
  col.names = rep("", length(display.cols))
) %>%
  group_rows(index = c("CB Geos" = 1)) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "striped"))
```
